result.instructions: Tools for SalesNOW, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the contacts that changed in SalesNOW today."; "Which deals are open for the company Acme Ltd?"; "Create a follow-up task for Ana Lopez due on Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SalesNOW data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run salesnow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run salesnow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run salesnow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. salesnow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: salesnow_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts records in SalesNOW, one page at a time. Reply: item_list (records) and total_count. Use modified_from and modified_to to limit the window. GET /models/contacts.

modified_from.description: Only records changed at or after this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

modified_to.description: Only records changed at or before this time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss).

tools.name: salesnow_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact record by id, with all its fields. GET /models/contacts/{id}.

id.description: The SalesNOW record id (from a list call).

tools.name: salesnow_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in SalesNOW from the given fields. This adds a record that the team can see. PUT /models/contacts.

fields.description: Record fields by name, for example {"first_name": "Ana"}. Use the metadata tool for field names.

tools.name: salesnow_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one existing contact. Fields you leave out keep their values. POST /models/contacts/{id}.

id.description: The SalesNOW record id (from a list call).
